## Calendly Event to CRM and Follow-up
Receives Calendly event webhooks, logs to CRM (Sheets), sends pre-meeting info via Gmail, and notifies via Telegram.

**Setup:**
1. Configure Calendly webhook to this workflow URL
2. Connect Google Sheets for CRM tracking
3. Set up Gmail and Telegram credentials
